title: DesiredGainR: Desired-Gain Selection Index and Quadratic Genomic Selection Index Tools for Plant Breeding
description:
An R package for multi-trait selection indices in plant breeding, built around the difficult task of defining a defensible breeding objective. When neither economic weights nor one exact desired-gain vector can be stated confidently, DesiredGainR supports trait-specific gain intervals, population-driven suggestions and feasibility analysis. It converts exactly between economic weights and desired gains, tests whether a stated objective is attainable, compares classical index families on identical data, and reports how far a recommendation depends on covariance estimates that are themselves uncertain.

Includes the Smith-Hazel, base, Pesek-Baker, Yamada, Mulamba-Mock, independent-culling and tandem families; the restricted and predetermined-proportional-gain indices of Kempthorne-Nordskog, Tallis, Mallard and Harville; the quadratic genomic selection index; multi-environment expansion with genotype-by-environment covariance; and forward simulation over breeding cycles through AlphaSimR.
